## Assigned reading

Read on of these:

- If you already feel comfortable with R & this isn't your first statistics class:
    - Introduction to Regression Analysis: A Data Science Approach: [Ch 4: Simple linear regression](https://introregression.netlify.app/04-slr)
- If you're new to R & statistics:
    - Introduction to Modern Statistics (IMS) [Ch 7: Linear regression with a single predictor](https://openintro-ims.netlify.app/model-slr)
